title: LEGS AND BALANCE
subtitle: SEATED FIRST, THEN STANDING WITH THE CHAIR. NO FLOOR TODAY. KIND HIPS.

script.welcome: Good morning Pam. I'm Stratton. Monday is legs and balance, about ten minutes. We start seated, rise up out of the chair, then finish with a couple of standing moves holding the chair. No floor today. Pain-free only, and a smaller range is perfectly fine on sore-joint days. Well done for showing up.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat, easy breath.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Settle in. No rush.
script.lastSet: Last one of these. Keep it comfortable.
script.complete: That's us, Pam. Legs and balance done, a proper little break from the desk and a fine start to the week. Have a sip of water. Well done.
script.pause: Paused. Take all the time you need.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat and hip-width, hands resting lightly on the sides of the seat. For about twenty seconds, march gently: lift one knee a few inches, lower with control, then the other. Easy rhythm to wake the legs and hips. Keep the torso tall and quiet. If the front of the left hip complains, make the left lift smaller or just lift the heel. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness. A smaller lift is perfect.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts to wake the legs up. Two easy rounds of twenty seconds. March gently, one knee then the other. Tall and steady. Smaller is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Feet flat. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Knee lifts done. Legs are awake.

exercises.name: SEATED FIGURE FOUR (LIGHT)
exercises.cue: Still seated tall, feet flat. Cross the left ankle lightly over the right knee into a gentle figure-four. Do not push the left knee down. Stay upright or add the tiniest hinge forward for a mild stretch in the outer left hip. Breathe slowly for about twenty seconds. Second set may repeat left or try the other side if it feels kind. If the front of the left hip pinches, skip this one entirely. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Seated figure four, nice and light. Two holds of about twenty seconds. Left ankle lightly over the right knee. Sit tall, no forcing. Skip it if the front of the hip pinches.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Uncross gently. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Figure four done. Kind work for the hips.

exercises.name: SIT TO STAND
exercises.cue: Sit near the front of the sturdy chair, feet flat and hip-width, a little behind the knees. Lean the chest slightly forward and press through the whole foot to stand up tall, then sit back down slowly with control. Use your hands on the thighs or the chair arms as much as you need — that is completely fine. Knees track over the toes. Five easy reps, no rushing. On a sore-joint day, use a higher seat or hands for help. If the front of the left hip pinches, keep the lean small. Stop for any sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Sit to stand, our leg strength move. Two rounds of five. Lean forward a little, press through the feet, stand tall, then sit down slowly. Use your hands as much as you like.
exercises.speakRest: Thirty seconds. Sit and breathe. Lovely.
exercises.speakDone: Sit to stand done. Strong legs, well done. Stay up on your feet for the last two.

exercises.name: STANDING HIP FLEXOR
exercises.cue: Stand beside the chair with the right hand lightly on the chair back. Step the left foot back about half a step — not a deep lunge — both feet pointing forward, knees soft. Gently tuck the pelvis under (belt buckle toward the ribs) until you feel a mild stretch at the front of the left hip. A tiny lean is enough. Breathe slowly for about twenty seconds. Small and kind, never aggressive. Stop if you feel sharp groin pain, spreading pain, numbness, tingling, or weakness.
exercises.speakStart: Standing now. Standing hip flexor, left leg back. Two holds of about twenty seconds. Small step back, pelvis tucked, tiny lean. Kind and small.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Feet together. Easy breath.

exercises.name: CHAIR BALANCE
exercises.cue: Stand behind or beside the sturdy chair with one or both hands on the chair back. Shift your weight onto one foot and lift the other heel, or the whole foot just an inch, for about fifteen seconds. Then switch sides. Eyes on a fixed point ahead, stand tall, breathe. Hold the chair as firmly as you need — that is the point of it. If the left hip grumbles when standing on it, keep the toes of the other foot lightly touching the floor. Stop if anything feels sharp or wobbly in a worrying way.
exercises.speakStart: Chair balance to finish. Two rounds of about fifteen seconds each side. Hands on the chair, lift one foot a little, eyes ahead. Hold on as much as you like.
exercises.speakRest: Fifteen seconds. Both feet down. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Balance done. That's the session, Pam. Lovely legs and balance. Have a grand Monday.
